answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents lock collateral in a vault to participate in game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. Graph auditing detects topological cut verifications around any suspicious identity island, identifying sparse boundary bottlenecks. When collusion occurs, coordinated audits trigger stake slashing that dissolves the cluster and releases a verifiable plume of fraud proofs. This imposes an exponential cost on attackers creating fake identities.
